sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The scheme "Retired Sportsperson Pension Scheme" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat aims to ensure financial security to retired state-level medal-winning sportspersons aged above 50 years through monthly pension assistance.
**Who is this for:** Sportsperson; Category: Sports & Culture; Sector: Sports

**Detailed Description:** The scheme &quot;Retired Sportsperson Pension Scheme&quot; by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat aims to recognize and support the contributions of state-level sportspersons who have won medals in national-level sports events by offering them a financial pension after the age of 50 years. The scheme ensures dignified post-retirement sustenance for these individuals, thereby encouraging younger generations to pursue sports professionally. The scheme is implemented by the Sports Authority of Gujarat.
**Benefits / Assistance:** - **Financial Assistance:** A Pension of ₹3,000/- per month.

Application Process: Step 1: The applicant should download the prescribed format of the application form. Step 2: In the application form, provide all the mandatory details, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). Step 3: Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the supporting documents to the Commissioner of Youth Services and Cultural Activities Office. Step 4: Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. > Commissioner, Youth Services and Cultural Activities Office, > Block No. 11, 3rd Floor, Dr. Jivraj Mehta Bhavan, > Gandhinagar, 382010.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Implementing agency: Sports Authority Of Gujarat; Nodal Department: Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department
